body: ## What's Changed * Scroll long library titles instead of truncating (Browse) by @mr-f0xx in https://github.com/mr-f0xx/sonix-player-tempotec-v1/pull/452 * Add a new app, a pocket vault, and retire the Metronome by @mr-f0xx in https://github.com/mr-f0xx/sonix-player-tempotec-v1/pull/455 * **Designed a Sonix firmware showcase website exclusively for the V1**. Available [here](https://mr-f0xx.github.io/sonix-player-tempotec-v1/) (The emulator is now on this page too) by @mr-f0xx in https://github.com/mr-f0xx/sonix-player-tempotec-v1/pull/458 * Qobuz search: three glyph buttons instead of three oversized pills by @mr-f0xx in https://github.com/mr-f0xx/sonix-player-tempotec-v1/pull/461 * Screensaver: Visualizer + Picture follows playback (#457) by @mr-f0xx in https://github.com/mr-f0xx/sonix-player-tempotec-v1/pull/467 * Show active (awake) time separately from total on-time in battery history by @mr-f0xx in https://github.com/mr-f0xx/sonix-player-tempotec-v1/pull/491 * aacdec: disable libfdk-aac DRC and loudness normalization by @mr-f0xx in https://github.com/mr-f0xx/sonix-player-tempotec-v1/pull/456 * Add Album Art Max blur toggle by @mr-f0xx in https://github.com/mr-f0xx/sonix-player-tempotec-v1/pull/496 * Listening stats: Top tracks, tappable top lists, and the Most played tile retired by @mr-f0xx in https://github.com/mr-f0xx/sonix-player-tempotec-v1/pull/497 * bluetooth: add RX SoftVolume toggle for A2DP sink by @mr-f0xx in https://github.com/mr-f0xx/sonix-player-tempotec-v1/pull/501 * Mark explicit M4A tracks and albums with an E symbol by @mr-f0xx in https://github.com/mr-f0xx/sonix-player-tempotec-v1/pull/502 **Full Changelog**: https://github.com/mr-f0xx/sonix-player-tempotec-v1/compare/1.7.6...1.7.7
